title: Kissed Arabian Kebabs with Onion Rings
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish featuring tender Arabian kebabs served with crispy onion rings.

ingredients.name: Arabian kebabs
ingredients.notes: Available in most middle eastern markets.

ingredients.name: Onion
ingredients.notes: Can be used for garnish as well.

instructions: Dust the onion rings with flour, then coat in bread crumbs.
Mix the egg and a pinch of salt in a separate bowl.
Heat 1/2 cup of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Dip the onion ring in the egg wash, then coat in bread crumbs again.
Fry the onion rings in batches until golden brown.
Bake the Arabian kebabs in the oven for 10 minutes.
Serve the kebabs with onion rings and garnish with chopped onion.
Season with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and paprika to taste.
